name: SCRUM-9 - Create ESS User
objective: Create a dedicated ESS user and verify its role, employee name, and status in System Users.
precondition: An eligible employee record is available and the administrator is logged in.

steps.description: Add a user with the ESS role, valid employee name, unique username, enabled status, and matching passwords.
steps.expectedResult: A success notification is displayed and the user is created.

steps.description: Search for the newly created username.
steps.expectedResult: The record shows the submitted username, ESS role, employee name, and Enabled status.
The test user is removed from System Users.
